question: Are your products suitable for all skin types?
answer: Yes! The Wash is formulated to be gentle enough for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Its blend of natural moisturizers and botanical extracts nourishes without causing irritation.

question: What ingredients are in your formulas?
answer: Our formulas are built around natural moisturizers and botanical extracts, free from harsh sulfates and parabens. Each product page lists the full ingredient list for complete transparency.

question: How do I choose the right product for my skin?
answer: Start with your skin type and main concern. Our product descriptions call out what each formula targets, so you can match it to your routine — or reach out and we'll help you pick.
